grain: one supplier product listing per public product_id
limitations: first 30 source-order records; not random or exhaustive
one supplier; no independent engineering or authenticity validation
no inventory, sales, demand, current pricing or cross-model fit fields
no trend claim from a single observation
publication dates do not prove launch or sales dates
assessment: Suitable for bounded title parsing, provenance and duplicate-key exercises; unsuitable as a universal compatibility or market dataset.
